description: A gray plastic tray with several clear ice cubes sits on the table, with a small yellow cup to the left and a purple scoop to the right. The right hand picks up the purple scoop and dips it into the tray to gather ice while the left hand steadies the tray; then the left hand lifts and holds the yellow cup under the scoop as the right hand tilts the scoop to dump the ice into the cup, before moving the scoop away.
